source.title: Process Piping - ASME Code for Pressure Piping, B31
source.note: Technical content only. Publisher front/back matter, running heads, printed folios and edition change markers are omitted. Values are as printed; the ASME ellipsis (no value / not permitted) is represented as null.

title: Minimum Schedule of Components With External Threads
notes: (1) Carbon steel is generally considered to be notch sensitive, whereas stainless steel is generally considered to be not notch sensitive.
(2) For sizes over DN 50 (NPS 2), the joint shall be safeguarded (see Appendix G) for a fluid service that is flammable, toxic, or damaging to human tissue.
(3) Minimum Schedules 40 and 80 are listed in ASME B36.10, which are identical to Schedules 40S and 80S listed in ASME B36.19 for DN 150 (NPS 6) and smaller.
